newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nikko Sec to revise earnings forecast.
newsitem.headline: Nikko Sec to revise earnings forecast.

text.p: Nikko Securities Co Ltd said on Tuesday it would announce a revision of its six-month and full year earnings forecasts for 1996/97 at 4.30 p.m. (0730 GMT).
A company spokesman declined to give further details.
However, industry sources said that the company would revise its earnings forecasts downward.

Nikko said in May that it expected parent current profit for the six months to September 30 at 38 billion yen and that for 1996/97 at 85 billion yen, based on an assumption that daily average turnover in 1996/97 will be about 520 billion yen. In 1995/96, parent current profit was 65.01 billion yen.
